Panely: ↑↓ PgUp PgDn Home End – pohyb, E:
Panels: ↑↓ PgUp PgDn Home End – move, Enter – open (folder, archive, file; run a shell script in the terminal),
⌘Enter – open with the system (.app applications, a file in its default application),
⌫ – parent folder, Tab – other panel, ⌃Tab – terminal line below the panels and back
(shell in the active panel's folder), ⌘F12 – terminal in the full window and back,
⌘T – new terminal tab (⇧⌘W close, ⌥⌘← / ⌥⌘→ switch, ⌘1–⌘9 by position in the terminal),
⌃Enter – item name to the terminal, ⌘N – new window,
Space / Insert / ⇧↑↓ / ⌘click – select, Num + / − / * – mask / invert,
⌘A – select all (again = unselect), ⌃D – nothing, ⌘D – duplicate, typing letters – quick search,
⌥← / ⌥→ – history, ⌘\ – root, ⌃H – hidden files.
⌘C / ⌘X / ⌘V – copy / cut / paste files via the clipboard (also from and to Finder);
files can be dragged with the mouse between panels, from and to other applications – like in Finder:
move on the same drive (copy with ⌥), copy to another drive (move with ⌘).
⌘. (⌃.) – send the current folder to the other panel (the other panel changes).
⌘⇧. (⌃⇧.) – take the folder from the other panel (the active panel changes).

F2 rename, F3 view, F4 edit, F5 copy, F6 move,
F7 new folder, F8 to Trash (⇧F8 / ⌘F8 permanently), F9 Terminal.app, F10 quit, F11 FTP/SFTP, F12 disconnect.
⇧F3 show in Finder, ⇧F4 new file, ⇧F7 go to folder, ⌘F2 / ⌃F2 attributes, ⌥↩ / ⌘I properties, ⌃P permissions, ⌃F3–F6 sorting, ⌃F9 refresh, ⌃F10 compare,
⌥F1/⌥F2 left/right drive (⌥↑/⌥↓ in the menu reorders drives), ⌘F1 / ⌃F1 drive information,
⌥F5 pack, ⌥F6 unpack, ⌥F7 find, ⌥F10 size.

The listed shortcuts are defaults – except for the arrows, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, Enter, Tab,
Esc, ⌫ and Space, they can be changed in Settings › Keyboard.

Tip: on a Mac keyboard the F-keys require Fn, or turn on
“Use F1, F2, etc. keys as standard function keys” in the keyboard settings.
